description: Luw.ai Interior AI: redesign an interior photo — home, office, shop, hotel — in any style while keeping the room's architecture. Restyles furniture, materials, colors and lighting. Set empty_room=true to furnish an empty room or turn it into another room type (virtual staging). Costs 1 credit per variation.

empty_room.description: Furnish from scratch / convert the room to room_type (Fill Empty Room mode).

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

image.description: Photo of the room (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

persona_id.description: Persona whose saved images and style knowledge to use.

precision.description: How strictly to keep the input's structure: 90 = precise, 75 = balanced, 40 = creative.

prompt.description: What you want, in plain language.

reference_images.description: Up to 6 reference images (furniture, materials, products, mood boards) to draw from.

items.description: Reference image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

room_type.description: Room type, e.g. "Living Room", "Kitchen", "Bedroom", "Home Office" (see luw_list_options kind="interior_types").

style_reference.description: Style-transfer source: an image whose look to copy (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI), or "persona" to use slot 1 of persona_id.

styles.description: Design style names, e.g. ["Scandinavian"]; for Japandi use ["Japanese Design", "Scandinavian"]. Case-sensitive; see luw_list_options.

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

name: luw_interior_design
title: Interior design (Interior AI)
